name: econsoc-template-plugins
description: Build inputs for plugins/econsoc.mjs, the bundled MyST plugin in this directory. Authors need none of this: myst.yml loads the committed bundle.
comment: Exact versions, not ranges: they are bundled into econsoc.mjs. myst-to-tex 1.0.48 and unified 10.1.2 are the versions mystmd 1.12.0 (myst-cli 1.12.0) ships; econsoc.mystmd is that release, which econsoc.mjs warns of when a build runs another.
